walls.note: The DeLaMar's rear and side walls stand behind 19-21 m Marnixstraat and Leidsekade houses; no panorama sees them (pitched looks up-n, up-nw, up-w, up-se in artifacts/landmark-lanes/delamar/aim/ show only the neighbours). Seen only from the air: PDOK 2025 orthophoto (artifacts/landmark-lanes/delamar/aerial/pdok-rgb.jpg) shows the fan-shaped auditorium roof, the light metal ridge strip and the grey standing-seam fly tower roof near the Marnixstraat. Walls in the same brown brick as the hall face seen over the Bellevue.

Curved back wall of the DeLaMar auditorium facing the gardens behind the Leidsekade houses (3DBAG ring edges 19-38 of 0363100012571556, 13.9-16 m). Not visible from any street; the orthophoto shows a light metal parapet along its top.
